ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. The daily cycle has already failed (broke its own start low). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 55.64. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 13 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 8d ago).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 55.64. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 13 of a typical 16–26 weeks

cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。日线周期已经失败（跌破其自身的起始低点）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。

ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 13 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 8 天前跌破其起始低点）。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
